name: Zoho Desk
description: Zoho Desk is customer-service software for ticketing, agent workflows, departments, products, knowledge bases, automation, analytics, and administration.
agentUseSummary: Connect the consent-selected Zoho Desk organization through Relay-owned Multi-DC offline OAuth. Agents may list at most twenty-five recently modified privacy-redacted ticket summaries or read one exact positive-numeric-ID ticket. Relay pins the organization, Accounts and Desk API data centers, tickets/basic read scopes, v1 endpoints, first page, limit, sort, returned fields, refresh, revocation, and approval boundary while excluding contacts, agents, descriptions, threads, comments, attachments, custom fields, broader support data, searches, writes, pagination, bulk APIs, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read tickets
capabilities.description: List bounded privacy-redacted ticket summaries or inspect one exact ticket in the consent-bound Zoho Desk organization.

approvalRequired.label: List tickets
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five recently modified privacy-redacted ticket summaries from the consent-bound Zoho Desk organization.

approvalRequired.label: Read ticket
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact privacy-redacted Zoho Desk ticket summary by positive numeric ID.

blocked.label: Change tickets
blocked.description: Creating, updating, assigning, moving, merging, commenting on, closing, restoring, or deleting tickets is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private support content
blocked.description: Contacts, accounts, agents, email, phone, descriptions, threads, comments, attachments, tasks, time entries, followers, tags, and custom fields are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader support data
blocked.description: Departments, products, teams, contracts, calls, events, knowledge-base articles, community, layouts, settings, analytics, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary searches or API calls
blocked.description: Other products, organizations, regions, scopes, endpoints, methods, fields, includes, filters, searches, query parameters, versions, and raw requests are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export support data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, deep offsets, synchronization, notifications, bulk APIs, downloads, imports, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded private ticket reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Both selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact organization, regional origin, scopes, static requests, limits, audit, redaction, refresh, revocation, and provider limits remain enforced.
